item.title: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
item.description: GEO is the practice of making a website discoverable and quotable by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Unlike traditional SEO, GEO optimizes for AI crawl access and for content formats that LLMs prefer to cite. Learn about the 25 categories Vigilath audits and how to improve your AI Visibility Score. Structured data, llms.txt, semantic HTML, and FAQ blocks are among the most impactful GEO signals. Early adopters report up to 40% more AI citations after optimization. Vigilath runs 100+ discrete checks and returns a prioritized fix list so you know exactly where to start.

item.title: How AI Crawlers Read Your Website — robots.txt, llms.txt, and .well-known
item.description: AI crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot identify themselves via User-Agent and expect explicit allow/deny rules in robots.txt. The llms.txt convention provides a machine-readable summary of your site specifically for large language models. The .well-known directory hosts manifests like ai-plugin.json for OpenAI plugins and security.txt for trust signals. Together, these crawl-access signals form the foundation of GEO readiness and directly impact whether AI engines can discover and cite your content.
